outcome: Placental pathology (acute necrotizing deciduitis, intervillous fibrin deposition, acute intervillositis)
cohort: Two infants born to mothers diagnosed with coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) in Korea.
finding: Clinical evidence of vertical transmission of SARS-CoV-2 was not found in these two cases, despite one newborn experiencing respiratory distress and both placentas showing signs of inflammation.
